name: backport
description: Opens backport PRs against long-running branches and gates the original PR until they are mergeable.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/index.js --minify --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
